scripts.dev: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; OPENPRONOUNCE_DEVICE=cpu PRELOAD_MODELS=false ENABLE_DOCS=true REQUIRE_API_KEY=false uv run uvicorn openpronounce_api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 --workers 1'
scripts.build: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv lock --check && uv run ruff check src tests'
scripts.start: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; OPENPRONOUNCE_DEVICE=cpu uv run uvicorn openpronounce_api.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000 --workers 1'
scripts.lint: bash -lc 'export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv run ruff check src tests && uv run ruff format --check src tests'
